entries.scene_heading: INT. FORGOTTEN CITADEL THRONE ROOM - MORNING
entries.description: Sunbeams slice through mossy gothic arches. SIR PIP (20s, earnest squire in oversized dented pauldrons) polishes a rusted bronze crown with a turnip cloth. Beside him, GLOOP (translucent emerald slime familiar wearing a tiny monocle) bubbles skeptically.

entries.scene_heading: INT. FORGOTTEN CITADEL THRONE ROOM - MORNING
entries.description: Behold, Gloop! According to the Royal Inventory of 842, whoever buffs the Crown of Eldoria inherits the entire Kingdom... and its tax exemptions.
entries.dialogue: Behold, Gloop! According to the Royal Inventory of 842, whoever buffs the Crown of Eldoria inherits the entire Kingdom... and its tax exemptions.

entries.scene_heading: INT. FORGOTTEN CITADEL THRONE ROOM - MORNING
entries.description: And according to the foreclosure notice nailed to the drawbridge, we owe the Stone Golem three hundred turnips by noon.
entries.dialogue: And according to the foreclosure notice nailed to the drawbridge, we owe the Stone Golem three hundred turnips by noon.

entries.scene_heading: INT. FORGOTTEN CITADEL THRONE ROOM - CONTINUOUS
entries.description: Sir Pip buffs a stubborn smudge. A hidden rune flares gold! The ancient STONE GOLEM BAILIFF (3 meters tall, mossy basalt plates, glowing amber eyes) rumbles awake behind the throne, holding a stone clipboard.

entries.scene_heading: INT. FORGOTTEN CITADEL THRONE ROOM - CONTINUOUS
entries.description: CITIZEN DETECTED. CROWN ACTIVATION FEE: FORTY GOLD COINS. WOULD YOU LIKE TO PAY BY COIN OR CATAPULT EJECTION?
entries.dialogue: CITIZEN DETECTED. CROWN ACTIVATION FEE: FORTY GOLD COINS. WOULD YOU LIKE TO PAY BY COIN OR CATAPULT EJECTION?

entries.scene_heading: INT. FORGOTTEN CITADEL THRONE ROOM - CONTINUOUS
entries.description: Aha! Good morning, Officer! Does the Crown's warranty cover... spontaneous abdication?
entries.dialogue: Aha! Good morning, Officer! Does the Crown's warranty cover... spontaneous abdication?

entries.description: Sir Pip gently places the gleaming crown onto Gloop's gelatinous head. Gloop freezes as the monocle pops off.
NEW MONARCH VERIFIED. HAIL KING GLOOP THE GELATINOUS. YOUR FIRST ROYAL DECREE IS DUE IN FIVE SECONDS.
entries.dialogue: NEW MONARCH VERIFIED. HAIL KING GLOOP THE GELATINOUS. YOUR FIRST ROYAL DECREE IS DUE IN FIVE SECONDS.

entries.description: Decree Number One: Sir Pip is officially promoted to Royal Turnip Peeler! Start peeling, peasant!
